verdicts.title: The determinant bound for discrepancy is almost tight
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In 1986 Lovasz, Spencer, and Vesztergombi proved a lower bound for the hereditary a discrepancy of a set system F in terms of determinants of square submatrices of the incidence matrix of F. verdicts.title: A Tighter Relation Between Hereditary Discrepancy and Determinant Lower Bound
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In seminal work, Lovász, Spencer, and Vesztergombi [European J.
